title: Retrieval Over Training: Similarity search-based Model Selection for Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.20243v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Anomaly detection is a fundamental task for time-series analytics, with important implications for the downstream performance of many applications. Despite the large number of anomaly detection methods proposed in the literature, recent benchmark studies have shown that no single detector performs best across highly heterogeneous time series. Therefore, a practical and scalable solution is to develop a model-selection method that, for a given time series, selects the anomaly detector most likely to perform well. Nevertheless, the model selection approaches proposed in the literature suffer from a significant drop in accuracy when applied in Out-of-Distribution (OOD) settings. In this paper, we tackle the aforementioned limitation and propose RAMSAD, a retrieval-based framework for model selection in time-series anomaly detection. translated_title: 检索优于训练：基于相似性搜索的时序异常检测模型选择方法
translated_abstract: 异常检测是时间序列分析中的一项基础任务，对众多应用的下游性能具有重要影响。尽管文献中已提出了大量的异常检测方法，但近期的基准研究表明，没有任何单一的检测器能够在高度异构的时间序列上始终表现最佳。因此，一种实用且可扩展的解决方案是开发一种模型选择方法，针对给定的时间序列选出最有可能表现良好的异常检测器。然而，现有文献中提出的模型选择方法在应用于分布外（Out-of-Distribution, OOD）场景时会出现显著的精度下降。本文针对上述局限性，提出了RAMSAD——一个基于检索的时序异常检测模型选择框架。给定一个新的时间序列，我们的方法会查询一个由先前观察到的实例构成的知识库，并检索……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出RAMSAD框架，通过相似性检索历史实例知识库而非训练模型的方式为新时间序列选择最优异常检测器，从而解决了现有模型选择方法在分布外（OOD）场景下精度大幅下降的问题。
en_tdlr: RAMSAD is a retrieval-based model selection framework for time series anomaly detection that selects the best detector for a new time series via similarity search over a knowledge base of previously observed instances instead of training, overcoming the accuracy drop of existing methods in out-of-distribution settings.
